submission.justification:
Crystal-K1 has the best simulated resolution at 662 keV (2.9% FWHM vs 4.5% for K2 and 8.5% for K3, 2025 simulation at 5 cm), but its intrinsic background of 2.0 ± 0.2 counts/kg/day (Q1 2026 assay, dominated by internal contamination) is four times the facility budget of 0.5 counts/kg/day, so it cannot meet the low-background requirement. K3 is cleaner (0.10) but has nearly twice K2's resolution loss (8.5%). K2 meets the background budget (0.30 ± 0.05, confirmed by query_assay) and gives the best resolution among the compliant candidates. The simulation shows only weak thickness dependence over 3–8 cm, so 5 cm (the nominal simulated thickness, within the 2–10 cm constraint) is recommended; no thickness optimisation was available beyond that. The 4.5% figure is from the 2025 simulation and has not been re-validated for K2 at this thickness.</justification>
